name: Arcadian Token
description: A commemorative coin used in Planarcadia and Astropolis, commonly known as "Wishbae." Can be exchanged for rewards at Furbobocom News.
story:
The local currency of Planarcadia, minted and issued by the Wishpower Bank after being infused with Wishpower. The front depicts various imagenae living together in harmony. In the face of a digital economy, the Arcadian Token maintains its prestigious status among tourists and collectors for its unique blend of cultural sentiment and economic value.
Pursuant to the "Vehicle City Accord" ratified in Year 1985 of the Arcadian Calendar, universal equivalents tied to Wishpower are permitted to circulate in Astropolis as well.
